_not: Plain, short English: the interface is meant to be usable by children and older people. Option values (auto, cuda, srt ...) stay as they are; they are what the settings file accepts.
onerilen.not1: The Dub button uses good default settings. It writes down what people say, finds the time of every word, tells the speakers apart and gives each one a fitting female or male voice, translates, speaks the new text and adds subtitles.
onerilen.not2: Every setting is under "Settings" in the top bar. What you change there is also used by these buttons. If two choices don't work together, you get a clear message when you press Start (docs/tarifler/kombinasyonlar.md).
onerilen.not3: To dub into another language, pick it in the "Choose the language" list (it is the same setting as genel.hedef_dil in Settings). For any target language other than Turkish, and for videos not in English, you need an LLM translator (Codex, Claude Code or your own API key; docs/getting-started.md).
onerilen.not4: Only use videos you own or have permission to use. The output file is marked "AI-dubbed".

ayar.genel.is_turu: Job type: "dublaj" (a video with the new voice) or "transkript" (only a text or subtitle file).
ayar.genel.arayuz_dili: Language of this app's screens: "auto" (the language of your computer, if we have it; otherwise English) or a language code.
ayar.genel.dublaj_kipi: Dubbing mode: "segment_sync" (sentence by sentence, timed to the video) or "full_text" (the whole text in one piece; only with Codex or Claude).
ayar.genel.hedef_dil: Target language (ISO 639-1 code). The list depends on the voice engine you picked (docs/diller.md): Supertonic 31 languages (no zh), XTTS v2 17 languages, VoxCPM2 tested in tr en fr de es ru zh ja (others with a warning). The local translator (Opus-MT) only makes Turkish; other languages need an LLM translator.
ayar.genel.transkript_bicimi: File type for "dubla transkript" / "Only subtitles / text": srt | plain (plain text) | timestamped (with times) | paragraph
ayar.genel.cihaz: Device: "auto" (the NVIDIA GPU if it works, otherwise the CPU) | "cuda" | "cpu"
ayar.genel.cikti_klasoru: Output folder. If empty: the "cikti/" folder in the repository.
ayar.genel.gozden_gecir: Review before voicing: if on, the job stops right after the translation, before the voice is made (state "inceleme_bekliyor", not an error). Fix the lines in the web screen, then continue with the voicing. Only in segment_sync mode.
ayar.transkripsiyon.motor: Engine. "auto" = CrisperWhisper Turbo CT2 if it is installed (best Turkish/English word timing, non-commercial license), otherwise faster-whisper. Choices: auto, faster-whisper, whisperx, crisperwhisper_turbo_ct2, parakeet_cpu_align, elevenlabs_scribe_v2 (cloud, your own key), youtube_translate (only with a YouTube link: the text comes from the video's subtitles + CTC; pip install .[youtube]). English only: parakeet_cpu_align. NVIDIA GPU only: crisperwhisper_turbo_ct2. Hardware table: docs/donanim.md
ayar.transkripsiyon.model: Model for faster-whisper / whisperx: large-v3-turbo | large-v3 | medium | small (many languages) | distil-large-v3 | distil-large-v3.5 (English only). Other engines have a fixed model and ignore this.
ayar.transkripsiyon.hesap_tipi: Number format (faster-whisper / whisperx): "auto" (GPU: float16, else int8; CPU: int8) | float16 | int8 | int8_float16 | float32. Other engines use their own fixed format.
ayar.transkripsiyon.kaynak_dil: Language of the video: "auto" (the engine finds it) or an ISO code ("en", "de", ...) to set it yourself. Which engine finds it how: docs/tarifler/dil_tespiti.md
ayar.transkripsiyon.vad: Skip silent parts (voice activity filter, VAD).
ayar.transkripsiyon.crisper_dil_tespiti: CrisperWhisper language detection: global_first_window (one language, from the first window) | continuous_stream (mixed languages in one talk: checks every second and finds where it changes)
ayar.transkripsiyon.whisperx_profili: WhisperX decoder profile: auto | whisperx_float32_quality_v1 (hesap_tipi=float32) | whisperx_engine_default_v1 (hesap_tipi=int8). Only for motor=whisperx.
ayar.ses_temizligi.kip: "original" (keep the source audio as it is) | "clean" (Demucs separates the speech) | "preserve_background" (Demucs; background music and sounds are mixed into the dub) | "auto_background" (keeps them when needed). Demucs is optional: pip install .[separation]
ayar.ceviri.arka_uc: Translator. "auto" = Codex CLI if installed, otherwise Claude Code CLI, otherwise the local Opus-MT. Choices: auto, yerel, codex, claude_code, gemini_2_5_flash, gemini_3_1_flash_lite_tier_1, gemma_4_26b, groq_llama_4_scout, cerebras_llama_3_1_8b, mistral_nemo (API translators use your own key, see .env.example). LLM translators give the best quality; the local Opus-MT only translates English to Turkish.
ayar.ceviri.codex.model: Codex CLI (OpenAI). Install: npm i -g @openai/codex ; sign in: codex login (your own account).
ayar.ceviri.codex.cli_yolu: Path to the Codex CLI. If empty: "codex" from PATH.
ayar.ceviri.claude.model: Claude Code CLI (Anthropic). Install: npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code ; sign in: run "claude" once and log in with your account.
ayar.ceviri.claude.caba: Effort level: low | medium | high ; full text translations longer than 6000 words use "high" by themselves.
ayar.ceviri.claude.cli_yolu: Path to the Claude Code CLI. If empty: "claude" from PATH.
ayar.ses.motor: Voice engine: "supertonic" (default; runs on the CPU) | "voxcpm2" (NVIDIA GPU, installed separately) | "ema_lightning" (Turkish only; GPU or CPU with ONNX; install: scripts/kur.ps1 -Adim tts-ema) | "xtts" (XTTS v2, optional: pip install .[tts-xtts]; non-commercial CPML weights; needs a reference voice)
ayar.ses.akis: Translation + voice flow (Supertonic): natural_blocks_1 (recommended) | single_pass_1 | single_pass_2 | single_pass_10 | repair_3_light | repair_2_initial_1_repair_2 | repair_1 .. repair_7. The candidate/repair flows only work with an LLM translator (codex, claude_code, APIs); with yerel they are ignored.
ayar.ses.hiz: Target length factor for the translation: the translation is asked to be a length that is read in source time × this value (default 1.2). It does NOT change how fast Supertonic speaks: each voice has one measured fixed speed (F1 1.30, F2 1.15, F3 1.30, F4 1.00, F5 1.15, M1 1.15, M2 1.00, M3 1.00, M4 1.15, M5 1.25; supertonic_tts/speed_policy.py).
ayar.ses.atempo: If the new speech is longer than the source, speed it up with ffmpeg atempo.
ayar.ses.voxcpm2_ses: VoxCPM2 single voice: "hazir/<name>" (ready voices), "<name>/<variant>" (a voice you designed) or the path of a voice folder. The default Turkish voice switches to that language's ready narrator for other target languages (en: hazir/anlatici_en, ...).
ayar.ses.voxcpm2_kadin_sesleri: VoxCPM2 favorite female voices (when voice by gender is on): a comma-separated list, handed out to speakers in order (the 1st female speaker gets the 1st voice, the 2nd gets the 2nd; at the end of the list it starts again). If empty: the target language's ready voices (Turkish female: hazir/belgesel_hanim, hazir/cekici_spiker). If there is no female voice, the male list is used. Example: voxcpm2_kadin_sesleri = "ayse/2, hazir/belgesel_hanim"
ayar.ses.voxcpm2_erkek_sesleri: VoxCPM2 favorite male voices: works like the female list. If empty: the target language's ready voices (Turkish male: hazir/haber_spikeri, hazir/tok_anlatici, hazir/gizemli_bilge; other languages: hazir/anlatici_<lang>).
ayar.ses.ema_cihaz: EMA Lightning has one voice (named "ema"; a designed, synthetic voice, not a real person), so there is no voice choice. For a different tone of the same voice, change ema_tohum. EMA device: "auto" (the GPU if there is one with at least 1 GB free, otherwise the CPU with ONNX) | "cuda" | "cpu"
ayar.ses.ema_hiz: EMA reading speed (0.5..2.0; 1.0 = the model's natural speed). This is not the same as the translation length factor "hiz".
ayar.ses.ema_tohum: EMA seed: same text + same seed = same voice (you can make it again); 0..2147483647
ayar.ses.konusmaci_cinsiyetine_gore_ses: Tell speakers apart + voice by gender (Easy start): the speakers are separated (3D-Speaker), each speaker's voice is guessed as female or male (wav2vec2 XLSR-53 classifier, LibriSpeech) and a voice is picked from the list: Supertonic female F1..F5, male M1..M5; VoxCPM2 voxcpm2_kadin_sesleri / voxcpm2_erkek_sesleri. If off, the whole video is read with one voice (supertonic_ses / voxcpm2_ses).
ayar.ses.konusmaci_sesleri: A voice for each speaker (wins over the guess): SPEAKER_00:M2, SPEAKER_01:F1
ayar.ses.cinsiyet_kipi: Gender mode: "konusmaci" (tell speakers apart + a voice per speaker) | "segment" (no speaker separation; the gender of each sentence is guessed on its own; the female/male voice comes from the pair below, in VoxCPM2 the first voice of each favorite list)
ayar.ses.xtts_referans_ses: XTTS v2 reference voice (a 6-15 s wav): only your own voice or a voice whose owner gave permission; required when ses.motor=xtts
ayar.ses.xtts_lisans_onayi: Accept the XTTS v2 weight license (Coqui Public Model License, non-commercial use only). true = I have read it and I accept (saved in a local file). More: docs/motorlar/xtts.md
ayar.ses.rvc_model: RVC voice conversion: the path of your own .pth model; empty = off. The official RVC WebUI is installed separately (docs/motorlar/rvc.md)
ayar.ses.rvc_riza_onayi: RVC consent: if the model's voice is not yours, its owner gave clear permission (RVC does not run without true; ETHICS.md)
ayar.video.akilli_kare: Smart crop: finds black or blurry bars at the video edges and cuts them off (optional: pip install .[akilli-kare]; if not installed, the original picture is used). Sound and subtitles do not change.
ayar.video.cq: Fixed quality value (lower = better quality, bigger file)
ayar.video.max_mb: Size limit for the max_mb rule (MB = 1 000 000 bytes); at least 1 when politika=max_mb
ayar.video.yapay_zeka_etiketi: Add the "AI-dubbed" label to the output file (we advise keeping it on)
ayar.video.tam_metin_sure_uyumu: Length matching in full_text mode: "audio_to_video" (the sound fits the video) | "video_to_audio"
ayar.ileri.tts_deneme: How many times to retry the voice engine
ayar.ileri.ornekleme_hizi: Output sample rate (Supertonic uses its own rate)
ayar.ileri.pyannote_konusmaci_ayrimi: Tell speakers apart in the transcript: whisperx (pyannote; accept the terms of two models on Hugging Face and set HF_TOKEN), elevenlabs_scribe_v2 (the cloud does it). CrisperWhisper, moonshine and cpu_align don't support it.
